newsitem.title: USA: Philippines buys at least 16,000 T US wheat - trade.
newsitem.headline: Philippines buys at least 16,000 T US wheat - trade.

text.p: The Philippines may have bought at least 16,000 tonnes combined shipment of U.S. dark northern spring and western white wheat over the past weekend, U.S. exporters said.
The wheat was divided into two lots of which 8,000 tonnes was DNS, 13.5 percent, and 8,000 tonnes western white for October shipment, they said.
But one exporter said he believed the Philippines bought about 30,000 tonnes. "We think there was a total of 1.1 million bushels," he said.

"It was about 300,000 bushels of white wheat and 800,000 bushels of spring for October. They have been looking at small lots almost nightly and typically do," he said. "I think that was probably done over the weekend," he said.
